prs.body:
Adds Fashionpedia pilot conversion, GT validation and a repeatable human review audit. Conflicting selections and disclosed answers remain separate; drafts are never automatically promoted to accepted.

Validated on AutoDL in wkq's isolated Python 3.10 CPU environment: 19 tests, existing contract fixtures, pip check, 20 images, 145 source-identical masks/crops and 218 package file checksums. Shared package: `/root/autodl-tmp/fashion-grounding/shared/processed/fp_pilot20_v2`.

Audit: 32 target agreements, 6 disagreements and 2 disclosed-answer groups. Accepted=0. The 34 category-only and 6 spatial groups are for interface checks; richer language data and human adjudication remain pending. B0, unified model evaluation and actual model consumer validation are not implemented by this change. No GPU training or optional extensions.

See `docs/handoffs/data_eval/remote_pilot_review_20261112.md` for reproduction and evidence. Data, original human reviews and credentials are not committed.

prs.body:
Provides lcy's Fashionpedia eight-class segmentation training/evaluation, candidate delivery and existing B1 integration. This revision completes the previously pending input-evidence reuse and bounded 5k/10k comparison launcher. Preparation is verified; no new training or inference was started.

### Composed input evidence

- New --input-validation-bundle evaluation option pins the prior completed dev report. C5k uses the unchanged-train path; D10k additionally binds the accepted expansion report, its original plan and execution record by SHA256.
- The evidence chain must agree on old 5k parent identity, new 10k identity, protected dev, eight-class mapping, old/new population and all four zero-overlap identity dimensions. Incomplete evidence, wrong parents, nonzero overlaps and changed files are rejected.
- The old reuse entry still rejects changed training fingerprints. Original reports and formal-freeze/human-review provenance are preserved.
- Live reuse verifies metadata hashes and the complete dev250 / 1,008-GT population. It does not open images, decode masks, recompute pHash or read test files. Future checkpoints still must match the actual training_data identity.

### Paired launcher, preparation by default

scripts/run_expansion_control.py prepares and displays commands by default. Only an explicit future --execute invocation starts C5k then D10k. Both use the same official COCO initialization, seed42, full min_scale0.5 recipe, batch2 and 20,000 successful updates. Each arm then evaluates its saved 10k/20k checkpoints on full dev250 at FP32 800/1333.

One absolute monotonic deadline per arm covers input receipts, training, both evaluations and selection: at most 10,800 seconds each and 21,600 seconds for the pair. The existing shared GPU lock, worker deadline, isolated process groups and Linux parent-death protection terminate owned descendants. Phases never reset the budget. Failure stops the pair; no automatic next arm, resume, retry or extension. Fresh outputs and consistent clean source are required.

Each arm selects within its own two complete reports. A separate comparison checks both endpoints and identical initial backbone/classifier digests, reports D10k-minus-C5k at20k and compares against the pinned historical B20k. No weights, candidates or ranking caches are replaced automatically.

### Actual validation and scope

- Eleven new CPU cases: ten passed locally; the Linux-only parent-death case passed separately on the server. Coverage includes evidence drift/incomplete chains, preparation-only routing, shared deadlines killing descendants, failure stopping later phases/arms, exhausted budgets rejecting launch, and paired selection with historical retention.
- Server source8b522a2: one metadata-only --check-inputs invocation passed for both actual training packages and the unchanged dev. Zero image/mask re-audits, model loads, inference images or optimizer updates.
- Final code e38b836 only adds failed-state bookkeeping when the budget expires before worker launch; that new branch was checked separately. Already passed server checks were reused. Evidence/docs commit4d60fcd.
- GPU remained0MiB/0%; no compute processes, active coordination records, planned GPU run records or future training output directory were created. Real three-hour GPU execution remains untested and was not authorized in this preparation task.
- Team GitHub branches, all five PRs, active discussions and incremental handoffs were checked first. wkq4b0584a, wyz103dcc5 and main7064ebb were unchanged. No teammate checkout, environment, data production, ranking or language work was modified.

The prior targeted10k technical acceptance remains valid: 10,000 images /39,699 instances; old5k preserved, new5k consumed once. It is not exhaustive human certification or three-party formal freeze. Historical B20k+800 remains the selected segmentation reference at AP63.7930; u18000/0.3 candidates and historical B1 delivery remain intact. Keep this PR draft and unmerged.

- [Launcher, evidence composition and actual preparation checks](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/expansion_execution_preparation_20261116.md)
- [Controlled comparison design](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/train10000_control_plan_20261116.md)
- [Targeted10k acceptance](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/train10000_acceptance_20261116.md)

prs.body:
项目需要统一、可追溯的数据和评价接口，避免试点标签、机器初标与正式测试结果混用。本 PR 汇总 data_eval 的真实数据转换、盲审与修订流程、共享规则解析器、B0 和统一评价核心，并交付版本化的大型数据包。

- 分割数据：5,000 train / 250 dev / 400 held-out test 图。保持官方边界，源 mask 不改写，validation 使用独立 ID 命名空间；哈希、资源地址及含镜像 pHash 保守分组。
- 语言数据：1,000 张训练图、1,580 组中英配对（3,160 条）；dev 116 图、145 组（290 条）。CPU 弱标注加有记录的 Codex 视觉修订，全部保持 needs_revision，新增 accepted 为 0；原小包 17 组 / 34 条 accepted 保留。
- 初标使用保守颜色条件、源纹样和几何；未知属性放弃判断。修订保留原文和证据，35 个按页审核页面不嵌入目标答案。accepted-only 正式评价门禁保持不变。

验证：远端独立 CPU 环境 93 项测试通过；五个包通过 schema/几何/hash 检查、独立 pycocotools 源 mask 逐像素一致性和候选裁剪检查；发布后逐文件 SHA256 核对。分割/训练查询/dev 查询分别视觉抽查 64/64/31 个目标；这不是全量质量认证。无 GPU 使用或模型训练。

限制：机器训练文件只供明确选择弱标注实验的输入；dev 仍有 134 张待补写，所有新增语言待人工审核。最终测试没有生成机器语言答案；新大包消费方验收、人工独立测试描述及三方正式冻结未完成。GT 试点诊断不是正式 dev/test 成绩。

详细路径、数据 hash、验证和下一步：[大型数据交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/large_dataset_20261112.md)；[P3 交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/p3_reviewed_baseline_20261112.md)。大型图片、标注输出和审核包保留在服务器共享数据盘，不提交 Git。

prs.body:
接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。
